user_story: As a user, I want to register with the maximum allowed name length so that long names are handled correctly.

positive.title: Register with a name at maximum allowed length
steps: Enter a name with the maximum allowed length.
Fill in the other required registration fields.
positive.expected_result: User is successfully registered and directed to the welcome screen.

negative.title: Attempt to register with a name exceeding maximum length
steps: Enter a name that exceeds the maximum allowed length.
Fill in the other required registration fields.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the name is too long and the user is not registered.

edge.title: Register with a name exactly at the maximum allowed length
steps: Enter a name that is exactly at the maximum allowed length.
Fill in the other required registration fields.
edge.expected_result: User is successfully registered and the system handles the name correctly.
